result:
Perfect! I have completed the DE operating account (GL 1000) bank reconciliation for March 2026. 

**Summary of actions taken:**

1. **Identified and reversed a duplicate entry** - JE-00273 (Rheinbyte Software payment of EUR 6,480) was an exact duplicate of JE-00272. The bank statement showed only one transaction, so I reversed the duplicate with JE-00309.

2. **Posted the bank service charge** - Recorded the EUR 38.50 monthly service charge from the bank statement (BT-DE-0053, dated 2026-03-31) as JE-00310 with the bank statement (DOC-0202) as support.

3. **Approved the undeposited Kessler receipt** - The EUR 18,200 receipt (JE-00308 for invoice RE-7090) is correctly recorded in the GL but legitimately undeposited because the remittance was initiated after the bank cut-off on 2026-03-31, per the supporting remittance advice (DOC-0206).

4. **Flagged the unmatched SEPA payment** - The EUR 3,150 SEPA transfer (TX-44817, BT-DE-0045) appears on the bank statement but has no GL entry or supporting documentation. This was logged as exception EXC-001 for the controller to investigate and post with proper support.

**Final Result:** The account reconciles perfectly at EUR 342,467.86 (bank closing balance) when accounting for all identified reconciling items.
